name: 薄荷绿屏障修复精华水款
description: 薄荷绿水感气泡光影套图，深绿面板收口，面部精华水通用

styleLock.direction: fresh aqua skincare commerce with subtle guochao accent
styleLock.backgroundSystem: porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshots, watery pale mint #DFF0E8 with soft caustic ripples for benefit and texture shots, deep spruce green #1E5A44 panels for pain-point header and closing screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, cool skimming highlights and subtle water-like reflections, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: clear glass and water-film surfaces, matte light-stone counter, seamless studio sweeps
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with one serif display weight reserved for headlines
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single deep green #1E5A44 stroke inside thin outline circles
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright bottle presentation, hero reads as the same object across the set, centred with soft contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh aqua skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain white #FFFFFF, watery pale mint #DFF0E8, deep spruce green #1E5A44 and one warm sand-gold accent #E4C89A; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and gentle water-like reflections; modern geometric sans-serif with one serif display weight for headlines; consistent thin-line icon style in deep green outline circles; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright bottle presentation with soft contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 angle, tall upright bottle centred, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the bottle
shots.whitespace: none, the bottle fills the frame edge to edge with only even margins
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A tall upright bottle standing centred, straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 angle, full product visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with no props and no decor. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K commercial skincare quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no QR code, no membership badge, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient or tinted background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.props: translucent soap bubbles and one thin warm sand-gold #E4C89A ribbon curl behind the bottle

Soft diffused studio light with a cool skimming light from the right, gentle caustic reflections. shots.props: four thin-line icon medallions in deep green outline circles along the header band

shots.intent: 以液滴微距证明清爽水润的质地与用料观感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, camera directly overhead at a 90-degree top-down angle onto a droplet on glass, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: cool skimming light from the upper right revealing liquid texture, controlled specular highlights, soft falloff
shots.background: pale watery mint #DFF0E8 falling out of focus beneath clear glass
shots.props: a few fine micro-bubbles inside the droplet
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture detail is the whole subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a glossy translucent droplet of the essence from {product} resting on a clear glass slide, tight zoom on the droplet dome and the fine micro-bubbles suspended inside. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera directly overhead at a 90-degree top-down angle, shallow depth of field with the droplet edge razor sharp. Cool skimming light from the upper right revealing the liquid texture with controlled specular highlights. Pale watery mint background #DFF0E8 falling out of focus under the glass. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame; minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking liquid, no invented ingredient names or percentages, no efficacy claims, no extra text, no watermark, no hands, no duplicated droplet patterns.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1为淡薄荷国风山水底上的绿玻瓶主图，带中英文标题与胶囊框；屏2上部为深绿四枚细线图标条，中部为四枚空白圆形痛点图位配四条困扰标签，下部进入功效章节标题；屏3为斜悬浮瓶与气泡、五枚气泡标注位，下半为成分章节01与气泡球素材；屏4为成分章节02（与01同名同文案，源页自相矛盾）加深绿产品信息卡（含品牌/规格/品名/核心成分/功效字段，规格为原文数值已弃用），底部进入达人推荐章节；屏5为达人推荐版式，左侧空白图位、右侧绿色评价卡，左下有会员促销角标与二维码。品类判定依据：屏4信息卡品名为屏障修复精华、英文名标 Essence Make-up Water，宣称均指向面部肌肤与毛孔护理，非头发护理，故由源夹名改判为护肤个护/面部护理。已剥离：素材站品牌字样、原文标题与评价原句、二维码与会员促销角标、原文规格数值、成分编号自相矛盾处（01/02两段同名成分且信息卡另列成分，均不作事实写入），功效断言与保证性文案一律替换为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位，产品以 {product} 占位。
